argument: The work must read as one suspended monolith before it reads as sixteen holes: shell mass, depth planes, chamfered rims, and the shared silhouette must hold the cavities together rather than forming a grid of nodes.

With labels, readout, controls, caption, and furniture hidden, the first view must read as a dark architectural body of negative space, not a network, register, loop procession, basin field, or generic WebGPU demo. After one commit, the contraction and remote widening must be findable in the object.

Pointer contact and focus movement must remain memory-neutral. Only Enter, Space, or the commit control may dispatch an absence; Delete must restore the exact preceding body and R must release all memory.

The selected cavity cannot directly become the opening. The least-attended remote cavity must widen, so situated attention is translated into a refusal of the addressed place rather than a cursor-following effect.

v028 leaves v024's duration, v026's two-place witness, and v027's traverse-and-depart field through a single-object negative-space composition, discrete focus-and-commit encounter, and an archive whose unit is a vacancy inside a load-bearing shell.

Delete v028 if the object is a decorative hole grid, if the commit is merely a selection highlight, if the remote opening is cosmetic, if shell plates never move, if later commits forget prior absences, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind object requires the caption to become collective.
